reported_steps.background: 31-year running median of annual non-sea-salt sulfur
reported_steps.detection: Annual value exceeds running median plus 3 times MAD
reported_steps.threshold_selection: Empirical, checked against known historical eruptions
reported_steps.deposition: Integrate excess above reduced running median after removal of detected volcanic peaks
reported_steps.background_uncertainty: 31-year running standard deviation of reduced running median

implementation_unknowns: Exact MAD sample domain and centering
Grouping flagged years into events and integration boundaries
distinctions: Detection threshold is not deposition baseline
Flagged year is not automatically a separate eruption
2013 chronology must not be copied as 2015 dates
